card.title: IPhone Unknown Part Message Causes

claims.statement: 'Unknown part' messages appear even with genuine parts from another iPhone unless Apple calibrates them.
Battery is flagged from iPhone XS/XR and SE 2020 on; display from iPhone 11; rear cameras from iPhone 12; rear system and TrueDepth camera from iPhone 13 through 15.

procedure: Check the model in the pairing table before quoting a part swap.
card.caveats: Based on Apple's published list at the time; iPhone 16 rules differ. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
